hints: Think about which animals have feathers.

hints: Water comes first and drying comes last.

D1-03.explanation: Wet, soap, scrub for 20 seconds, rinse, then dry.

hints: A prime number has exactly two factors.
Check each number: can it be divided evenly by anything besides 1 and itself?
